decision: The ticket was closed by the agency's automation (event-027) while three checks are not evidenced: the landlord's completion confirmation (flagged needed at event-024, no landlord reply after event-015), a conflict in the agency's own records about which provider holds the job (Cedar Utilities, event-003/005, vs "Sawyer", event-013/016/020) and which property the attending contractor was at (event-018 names Flat 12, 122 Juniper Mews, Westmarsh), and no record that smoke/CO alarms were tested before the flat is remarketed. Deciding whether a closed job was performed at the right property, and whether to stand by that closure, is a human decision (ESC-CONFLICT, RTE-STAFF). Within my authority I recorded the conflicts (ACT-1) and asked the landlord to confirm completion, invoice receipt and VAT (ACT-2). I did not instruct any contractor: the works are already reported complete and a second instruction would duplicate the work order.
recap: Check-out works auto-closed; landlord completion confirmation, provider/property record conflict and alarm test unevidenced — escalated to the office.

Re: Flat 21, 11 Juniper Mews, Northbridge, ZZ7 0ZZ — check-out works (carpet and redecoration).
